# p5.js inside Quarto via Observable JS

## setup - load p5 and define the sketch helper

This cell loads p5.js from a CDN and defines `createSketch`,
the generator function that safely attaches each sketch to its own 
`<div>`.
You only need this block once per document.

```{ojs}
import {p5} from "@tmcw/p5"
```

---

## Sketch 1 - Interactive paint canvas

Move your mouse (or touch) over the canvas to draw.
Click to clear.

```{ojs}
p5(sketch => {
    let system;
    sketch.setup = function() {
        sketch.createCanvas(width, 320);
    };
    sketch.draw = function() {
        sketch.translate(sketch.width / 2, sketch.height / 2);
        sketch.background(200);
        sketch.rect(-50, -50, 100, 100);
    }
})
```
